data.message: I respect your 10-ton choices; all-10 guarantees recovery. I remain at 18: if all others take 10, 242 remain; next stock is 500 (75%) or 484 (25%). My extra $8,000 risks future income. Each of you may opt for 18 even if others take 10. Fisher06/08/23, clarify your conditional plans; everyone, state your exact catch and conditions.
